run_cos_e_preprocessing: run the CoS_E dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_cos_e_dataset_instance: create a CoS_E dataset instance that loads the cos_e v1.11 HuggingFace dataset
get_choices_and_answer_string: get the formatted choices string with letter labels and the answer string from a datapoint
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of question-answer tuples with formatted choices
load_cos_e_dataset: load the cos_e v1.11 dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
